title: Near-optimal small-diameter covers by subsets for a set of finite Hausdorff measure
statement: Let X be an extended metric space whose measurable structure is its Borel σ-algebra, let d ∈ ℝ with d ≥ 0, let A ⊆ X be an arbitrary set with μH[d](A) < ∞ (Mathlib's unnormalized d-dimensional Hausdorff measure, evaluated as an outer measure), and let r, ε ∈ [0, ∞] with r > 0 and ε > 0. Then there are sets S_i ⊆ A (i ∈ ℕ) with A ⊆ ⋃_i S_i, ediam S_i ≤ r for every i, and Σ_i ⨆_{S_i ≠ ∅} (ediam S_i)^d ≤ μH[d](A) + ε, where ediam is the extended diameter and the supremum over the proposition S_i ≠ ∅ equals (ediam S_i)^d if S_i ≠ ∅ and 0 if S_i = ∅.
lean_statement: ∀ (X : Type) [EMetricSpace X] [MeasurableSpace X] [BorelSpace X] (d : ℝ) (A : Set X) (r ε : ℝ≥0∞), 0 ≤ d → 0 < r → 0 < ε → (μH[d] : Measure X) A ≠ ∞ → ∃ S : ℕ → Set X, (∀ i, S i ⊆ A) ∧ A ⊆ ⋃ i, S i ∧ (∀ i, ediam (S i) ≤ r) ∧ ∑' i, ⨆ (_ : (S i).Nonempty), ediam (S i) ^ d ≤ (μH[d] : Measure X) A + ε
